spans.s: टक् krt affix अ, not admitting गुण or वृद्धि to the preceding vowel and causing ङीप् in the feminine ( by
), added to the roots गा, पा and हन् under certain condi- tions; e. g. समग;, सुरापः, पतिघ्नी etc.; cf.
टकार the consonant ट्, कार being added for facility of utterance; cf. वर्णात्कारः
